CERTIFIED PUBLIC ACCOUNTANTS
AND CONSULTANTS

Independent Auditors’ Report on Supplementary Information

To the Board of Directors of
Scout Trading, LLC:

Our report on our audit of the basic financial statements of Scout Trading, LLC for the
period from inception [February 5, 2009] to December 31, 2009 appears on page one. That audit
was made for the purpose of forming an opinion on the basic financial statements taken as a
whole. The supplementary information on pages 11 and 12 is presented for purposes of
additional analysis and is not a required part of the basic financial statements. Such information
has been subjected to the auditing procedures applied in the audit of the basic financial
statements, and, in our opinion, is fairly stated in all material respects in relation to the basic
financial statements taken as a whole.
